sources.title: README.md · deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp at main
sources.snippet: We are excited to introduce DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, our first experimental multimodal model in the DeepSeek-V4 family. It builds on the DeepSeek-V4-Flash architecture by incorporating visual modules and undergoing continued training to unlock visual understanding capabilities.

sources.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: DeepSeek's first experimental multimodal V4 model — the V4-Flash MoE backbone plus a 32-layer vision tower, 1M context, and a fused DSpark draft module.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision: Images, Same Price, Two Clocks
sources.snippet: deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp is live on the DeepSeek API with text and image input and text output. Shipped alongside it: a Files API for image reuse that DeepSeek states is free, and DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1, a same-day point release of the agent runtime that launched as v0.1 on August 13, with out-of-the-box support for the new model (our Harness write-up covers the runtime itself). sources.title: DeepSeek V4-Flash-Vision-Exp: Multimodal Agent Benchmarks - explainx.ai
sources.snippet: DeepSeek shipped DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1 on the same day with out-of-the-box support, and the model is live now via model='deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp'. This follows a pattern explainx.ai has tracked all August: DeepSeek shipping V4 Pro 0813, a 50-1,100% API price increase, and verified ARC-AGI numbers for V4 Flash 0731 in rapid succession.
